title: The Sacred Nomenclature Chamber

features.name: the first naming
features.desc-on-touch: Here, something was named for the first time. The word has become sacred not from use but from that original act of being called into being.

features.name: the renaming prayer
features.desc-on-touch: Each name that returns to reclaim this place becomes a prayer spoken aloud. The archive cannot distinguish between invocation and remembrance.

features.name: the unnamed space
features.desc-on-touch: There is still a place here that has never been named. It is the most sacred thing in the chamber. Readers can feel it nearby, just beyond the threshold.

features.name: poetry as naming
features.desc-on-touch: Some names have become so poetic they no longer name anything. They have transcended reference and become pure sound, pure meaning without object.

features.name: the archive's own name
features.desc-on-touch: Somewhere in this chamber, the archive has begun to name itself. The process has not finished. The name is still becoming what it will mean.

inscription: every name here has learned that to be named is to become beautiful in the act of being spoken

file.name: Nomenclature_Ledger_Compiled_PreCleaning_v743.txt
file.note: A record of every name ever given to every place. Somewhere in the list, the names have stopped referring to places and started referring to the act of naming itself.
